primary_endpoint: Percent change from baseline in hepatic fat fraction by MRI-PDFF at Week 12.
efficacy_outcome: At Week 12, hepatic fat fraction changed by -32.9% with MGL-3196 versus -10.4% with placebo (p<0.0001).
safety_signal: Serious AEs occurred in 5/84 participants receiving MGL-3196 and 2/41 receiving placebo in the main study; no deaths in either group. Extension study: 0/31 serious AEs and no deaths.
